sessionCookie.description: Session cookie set by POST /api/v1/session. Its name is unagikuma_session_ followed by the installation id (see GET /api/v1/license), so several installations on one host keep separate sessions. Non-GET requests must also send the session's CSRF token in the X-Unagikuma-CSRF header.

info.description: The REST API of the Unagikuma monitoring server. Authenticate with the session cookie (unagikuma_session_<installation id>, from POST /api/v1/session) or an API token sent as a Bearer token. Tokens carry scopes: read, ack, write, admin (write implies ack implies read); each operation lists the scope it needs in x-token-scope. Session-authenticated writes must send the session's CSRF token in the X-Unagikuma-CSRF header. Every failure uses the same JSON error body (see the Error schema); error codes are stable strings. Lists come as {"items": [...]} and are never null; a DELETE answers 204 with no body; times are RFC 3339 with milliseconds. The cluster protocol under /api/v1/agent/ is between the machines of a cluster (mutual TLS) and is not part of this API.
